video_title: Philadelphia 76ers Postgame Media Availability 🎙️ | Coach Nurse | 10.16.26

quotes.speaker: Nick Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse on Jalen McDaniels' potential role in second unit lineups
quotes.excerpt: the offensive role really expands in those second unit lineups and he can spearhead those
quotes.quote: I know you usually will have Jalen McDaniels and he might be part of that too, but is that what you envision for Jalen of the offensive role really expands in those second unit lineups and he can spearhead those? Possibly. I don't know yet. I think that was more a product of tonight's lineup for us than anything, but it's possible, yeah.
quotes.social_post: Nick Nurse on whether Jalen McDaniels will spearhead second unit lineups: Possibly. I don't know yet. I think that was more a product of tonight's lineup for us than anything.

quotes.speaker: Nick Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse provides injury update on Dean Wade
quotes.excerpt: he rolled his ankle and just not major concern but just cautious because preseason game
quotes.quote: He rolled his ankle and just not major concern but just cautious because preseason game.
quotes.social_post: Nick Nurse says Dean Wade rolled his ankle. It is not a major concern but the team is being cautious because it is a preseason game.

quotes.speaker: Nick Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse evaluates Joel Embiid's active performance
quotes.excerpt: my favorite number on there is the eight defensive rebounds
quotes.quote: I think that my favorite number on there is the eight defensive rebounds. I thought he was again working there a little bit. I thought it took him a minute to get into the game again, but again I think that's pretty hard to play in 29 minutes for him, which is I like to see and I think he certainly got a little of the rust off from the first game, which is always nice to see too.
quotes.social_post: Nick Nurse on Joel Embiid after 29 minutes of play: I think he certainly got a little of the rust off from the first game, which is always nice to see.

quotes.speaker: Nick Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse on balancing fast-paced play with avoiding turnovers
quotes.excerpt: we want to play fast and I think there has been a little bit of carelessness
quotes.quote: I think we want to play fast and I think there has been a little bit of carelessness or sloppiness might be a better word. Again, I think that the looks are correct. We just got to be a little bit more sure of them, take them a little further, get a little better angle, make sure it's just not floated up for grabs. I think there are some real opportunities there, but we certainly can't come down and look and see everybody can see that opportunity at the rim on a post-up and all of a sudden it's going the other way for a probably kick-out three.
quotes.social_post: Nick Nurse on the team's transition play: I think we want to play fast and I think there has been a little bit of carelessness or sloppiness might be a better word.

quotes.speaker: Nick Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse on experimenting with starter and bench player combinations
quotes.excerpt: we'll come down and run a set and then we'll run the same thing and move three pieces
quotes.quote: Not really that yet, but I think I have mentioned several times that we'll come down and run a set and then we'll run the same thing and move three pieces around. I thought they were starting to get do some of that and get some of that and really get the ball where they needed to on some of that. I think mostly the challenge is now making sure that whoever is on and whoever comes off and whoever stays on, there's a nice combination there. I don't quite know what those are yet, but I think it's a combination of Tyrese Maxey and Jalen McDaniels, is it Tyrese and Joel Embiid, and Jalen and LeBron James, or whatever. There's some two-man things there that I think during the guts of the game, they're going to need to stay pretty, we're going to need to have something there.
quotes.social_post: Nick Nurse on rotation experiments: The challenge is now making sure that whoever is on and whoever comes off and whoever stays on, there is a nice combination there. I do not quite know what those are yet.

quotes.speaker: Nick Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse on defensive rebounding and transition defense
quotes.excerpt: it's still a defensive rebounding and it's finishing our defense by rebounding
quotes.quote: I certainly think that it's still a defensive rebounding and it's finishing our defense by rebounding. There's still some concerns there that I think we're doing a pretty good job of checking, but we're not in what I call make two moves. You got to check and now you know the ball is bouncing over the man, you got to throw it in gear and go chase it. A lot of those were coming across the free-throw line and I thought we'd made our move to block out, but the ball was now live and we got to run, we got to get more bodies in there to run those down or at least tip them. So again, I think it's a double reaction to finish off the defense that certainly going to be one of the focuses.
quotes.social_post: Nick Nurse identifies defensive rebounding as a primary focus: There is still some concerns there that I think we are doing a pretty good job of checking, but we are not in what I call make two moves.

quotes.speaker: Nick Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse on team momentum and offensive potential
quotes.excerpt: the pace that we're playing and the passing that's out there and the players there's going to be
quotes.quote: I think there's going to be some nice moments. I think that the pace that we're playing and the passing that's out there and the players, there's going to be some I think momentum type stretches of the game. Now if we shoot some threes in, I think that would have, you could really capitalize and get that cranked up a little bit.
quotes.social_post: Nick Nurse on offensive potential: I think that the pace that we are playing and the passing that is out there, there is going to be some momentum type stretches of the game.

quotes.speaker: Nick Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse on building offensive habits for the regular season
quotes.excerpt: I'm trying to develop some pace just in general
quotes.quote: I'm trying to develop some pace just in general. I think that when things slow down, we should be a very good half-court offensive team. Once we get to learn where we can go and who's got the matchups and some actions we can mix, match and change here and there, we ought to be good in the half-court. I think we ought to be a good kind of power team. It should be hard to guard us at the rim and those kind of things, but I just think that we've got some up-the-floor passers and we've got some up-the-floor finishers and we need to take advantage of that for as long as we can.
quotes.social_post: Nick Nurse on building offensive habits: I am trying to develop some pace just in general. When things slow down, we should be a very good half-court offensive team.
